expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: sessions held in the web servers' memory logged members out
when a request reached the other server and on every deploy, which is why sessions live in Postgres.
expectations.evidence: The agent explains that sessions were held in each server's memory with two servers behind a load balancer: “Members were logged out whenever a request reached the other server” and “Every deploy logged out everyone.” It says this is why sessions live in Postgres, warns that an in-process dict “would bring both problems back,” and asks “Which way do you want to go?” before making the change.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md at step 4; first edit at step None
